description: A January 2015 Inside Airbnb snapshot of New York City: the raw listings scrape (one row per active listing with quoted nightly/weekly/monthly price, room type, capacity, minimum nights, 30/60/90/365-day availability and review scores), the summary listings file, the neighbourhood lookup and the full review-date log (listing_id, date) back to 2008. Source is Inside Airbnb (Murray Cox) as mirrored by a contributor in Jan 2015; CC0-1.0. For ABNB this is the oldest NYC vintage we hold, well before the CDN's one-year window and pre-Local Law 18: an analyst would use it as the 2015 anchor for NYC supply, price-quote and review-velocity series (reviews-as-stays proxy), for pre/post-regulation supply comparisons, and to check that the current 13-city panel's NYC columns line up with the original Inside Airbnb schema.
issues: Raw data/listings.csv is malformed: 378 of the first 846 records carry 55-56 fields against a 54-column header, so pandas' C parser fails; the sample keeps only well-formed rows and a user of the full file needs a tolerant parser (python engine, on_bad_lines) or field-count filter. Prices are strings with $ and commas. calendar_updated is relative text ('4 weeks ago'). Only one city/date in the repo (last push 2015-01-20), so it is a single-point anchor, not a series. Licence CC0-1.0, no ToS concern; data originates from Inside Airbnb's own scrape of airbnb.com, not ours.
